input.quote: 1.1 HDI shall design, develop, implement, operate, maintain and manage, and enable the Company to establish a presence on the World Wide Web
input.rationale: HDI designs and develops the Site at its own cost (§§1.1-1.3, 1.6) and holds our Content (§2.1), Marks (§6.1) and customer e-mail lists (§7.1), yet the Agreement contains no ownership or assignment provision anywhere. We have artistic and editorial control (§5.2) and grant HDI a trademark licence, but nothing confirms that we own the Site deliverables, our Content or the customer/transaction data generated through the Site, and nothing addresses HDI IP embedded in the Site. Section 10.2's co-ownership disclaimer is a partnership carve-out, not an IP allocation. Given we fund the Site through the Net Sales revenue share and a Termination Payment, the playbook preferred position (Customer owns deliverables and data; Vendor retains background IP with a perpetual licence back; no joint ownership) should be added.

proposal.summary: Add an ownership section: Company owns the Site deliverables, Content, Marks and customer data; HDI retains its platform with a perpetual licence back; no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership, so we added a clause confirming that we own the Site and other deliverables HDI develops for us as well as our Content, Marks and customer data, with no assignment of any of it to HDI. HDI keeps its pre-existing platform and tools and grants us a perpetual, royalty-free licence to anything embedded in the Site; if HDI resists the assignment, we can accept that licence-back over the Deliverables instead.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. (a) The Company shall own all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Marks, the Company's customer lists and customer e-mail lists, and all data relating to visitors to, and purchasers from, the Site (collectively, "Company Materials"), and nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers any Company Materials to HDI. (b) The Site, including its design, look and feel, the code developed for the Site, and all other deliverables and work product created by or for HDI for the Company under this Agreement (collectively, "Deliverables"), shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Company, and HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest in and to the Deliverables. (c) HDI shall retain ownership of its pre-existing software, hosting platform, Content administration tools and generally applicable know-how ("HDI Materials"), and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive license to use, modify and sublicense any HDI Materials embedded in, or necessary for the Company's use of, the Deliverables. (d) No Deliverables, Company Materials or other intellectual property shall be jointly owned by the Parties.
